title: fix(cli): respect OPENAI_MODEL precedence in CLI model resolution

target.summary: Prioritizing OPENAI_MODEL and QWEN_MODEL ahead of settings.model?.name causes model selections saved in settings (such as via /model) to be silently overridden whenever OPENAI_MODEL is set in the environment.
notes: faulty precedence prioritizing OPENAI_MODEL and QWEN_MODEL over settings.model?.name when resolving requestedModel
